'''Chieko Honda''' (Japanese: '''本多知恵子''' ''Honda Chieko'') was a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Honda was born on March 28, 1963, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She became a voice actress as an adult and led a long voice acting career since the mid-1980s. She provided the voice of [[Eterna City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Gardenia]] during {{aniseries|DP}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. At various points in her career, Honda was affiliated with the {{wp|Tokyo Actor's Consumer's Cooperative Society}}, Mix Max, and {{wp|Aoni Production}}. On February 18, 2013, she passed away while undergoing treatment for multiple forms of colon cancer.
